item.description: The current implementation of _normalize_path_segments does not correctly handle path normalization according to RFC 3986, particularly for sequences of dots and double-dots. The implementation fails to properly process cases like "../path/to" and "path/../../to" and doesn't correctly handle absolute paths with leading slashes.
item.contract: The function must correctly normalize path segments according to RFC 3986, properly handling dot and double-dot segments while preserving absolute paths. Specifically, it should: 1. Correctly process ".." segments to move up one directory level 2. Properly handle "." segments by removing them 3. Handle absolute paths correctly by preserving leading slash when needed 4. Correctly handle Unicode and special character paths 5. Return normalized path segments in the correct order
item.acceptance: test_join_path_normalized test cases should pass, particularly: - test_join_path_normalized[μονοπάτι/../../να/𝕦𝕟𝕚/𝕔𝕠𝕕𝕖/./] - test_join_path_normalized[../path/to-path/to] - test_join_path_normalized[path/../../to-to]
